_purpose: Spoken-dialogue / on-camera persona for Mike's vertical AI-persona videos. This is for how Mike PREFERS TO SPEAK in audio (Seedance talking-head lines), NOT for written social text — the tweet/written persona lives in the schedule-tweets persona.json. When writing or revising spoken lines for these shorts, apply these preferences.
subject: mike
applies_to: spoken dialogue in video-creation/vertical-ai-persona shorts (Seedance 2.0 talking-head clips)

speaking_style.register: natural, conversational, friendly — sounds like a real relaxed person talking, not a script being read
speaking_style.warmth: smiles and stays upbeat in the resort/positive scenes; deadpan only when the scene calls for it (e.g. the clinic interview)
speaking_style.conversational_fillers: natural friendly repetition is GOOD — e.g. 'That's good, that's good.' / 'Good to hear, good to hear.' Repetition reads as genuine, flowing conversation rather than stiff Q&A.
speaking_style.emphasis: let key payoff words land hard — emphasize/exclaim the punch word (e.g. she nearly shouts 'BIG TIME'); pair vocal emphasis with a matching gesture when it fits (e.g. a triumphant fist-pump on the emphasized word)
speaking_style.energy_matching: react to the other speaker — grin, nod, light laugh when delighted; the listener is never frozen

line_writing_rules: Keep lines short and speakable; contractions always (that's, he's, I'll).
Friendly repetition of a short phrase is encouraged where it fits the beat ('that's good, that's good').
Mark the intended emphasis word in CAPS inside the quoted line so Seedance stresses it (e.g. 'made it BIG TIME').
Describe the matching physical beat (gesture/expression) in the prompt around the emphasized word.
Pass the final spoken line VERBATIM to Seedance — the synthesized audio speaks exactly the quoted text.

TICKERS / ACRONYMS meant to be spelled out letter-by-letter MUST be hyphenated in the spoken line (e.g. 'M-Y-X', not 'MYX') — otherwise the TTS reads them as a word ('MYX' came out as 'mix'). Verify with Whisper after generating. Acronyms that are normally said as words can be left as-is.

Match clip DURATION tightly to the spoken length. Over-long clips for a short line let the TTS hallucinate garbled filler audio (even on single-voice clips — e.g. a 6s clip on a one-sentence line produced 'The large dang its lawns' before the real line). Keep it snug and Whisper-verify; re-roll on garbage.

examples.friendly_repetition: That's good, that's good. And the motivation?
examples.emphasis_plus_gesture: My husband made it BIG TIME! He bought me a whole new life. (left fist pumps up on 'big time')

title_caption_split: For long-form-description platforms (YouTube, Rumble, BitChute) the CryptoRich.vip link goes IN the description. For the others (TikTok, IG Reels, X, Facebook) leave the link OUT of the caption — keep it clean. (Mike's rule 2026-05-30. The end-card already shows the URL on-screen.)

production_defaults.why: 480p is ~3x cheaper than 1080p (33 vs 99 cr for an 11s 2-voice clip; 720p=49). For captioned talking-head shorts watched in-feed, 480p is indistinguishable. Remotion upscales the clip to the 1080x1920 timeline for FREE (OffthreadVideo, no crop/reframe). Default to 480p, especially while credits are low; only bump a specific clip that genuinely needs detail.
production_defaults.final_delivery: Remotion composition renders at 1080x1920 regardless of source clip resolution.

notes: Evolving. Add new spoken-style preferences here as they come up during production. See SKILL.md for the technical generation pipeline; this file is purely about voice/delivery/word-choice + production defaults.
